paragraphs.text: Tulan was the Master of the Gray House of Kestha , in the city of Estark on Dominaria . He participated in the Night of Fire , the destruction of the House of Oor-tael . He was considered the least dangerous of the House Masters.
He was just over six feet tall, but very overweight, with heavy jowls and sausage-like fingers adorned by rings. Tulan was very gluttonous, often eating and drinking in considerable quantities.

He was killed when the Grand Master of Arena Zarel decided to destroy the four Houses. Uriah , the captain of Zarel's fighters, sapped the strength from his body. Tulan then destroyed the satchel containing his spells and threw himself off the wall of his House as Uriah set him aflame.
